::: {#def-ffrcistg .theorem}
## FFRCISTG model

A finest fully randomized causally interpretable structured tree graph (FFRCISTG) is a [causal model](#def-causal-model) of an [NPSEM](#def-npsem) $\mathcal M$, relative to DAG $\mathcal G$, under intervention regime $\Gamma$, in which $\mathcal M$ satisfies (1) [no contagion](#def-no-spillover), (2) [no interference](#def-no-interference), (3) [identical structural distributions](#def-identical-distributions), and (4) [single-world independence](#def-single-world).
:::
